data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (timeanddate, then weather.com 10-day, then a mail draft to family@example.com that is discarded) with the right city, day and person/relative parameters, but "Lille" is hardcoded, "local time" and "forecast" are listed as parameters when they are read from the pages, the forecast is never tied to the specific day, and the body wording and the clicks and tab switches are vague.
